# Conditional Value at Risk

```{r}


# --- Simulate 10 years of yield data ---
set.seed(123)
years <- 1:10
yield <- rnorm(10, mean = 4.5, sd = 0.8)  # e.g., tons per hectare

data=data.frame(year = years, yield = yield)

# --- CVaR function ---
cvar <- function(x, alpha = 0.1) {
  q <- quantile(x, probs = alpha)
  mean(x[x <= q])
}

# --- Compute CVaR at 10% and 20% ---
cvar_10 <- cvar(data$yield, alpha = 0.10)
cvar_20 <- cvar(data$yield, alpha = 0.20)

cat("CVaR at 10%:", cvar_10, "\n")
cat("CVaR at 20%:", cvar_20, "\n")

# --- Visualization ---
hist(yield, breaks = 8, col = "lightblue", main = "Yield Distribution",
     xlab = "Yield (tons/ha)")
abline(v = quantile(yield, 0.10), col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
abline(v = quantile(yield, 0.20), col = "orange", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("10% quantile", "20% quantile"),
       col = c("red", "orange"), lty = 2, lwd = 2)



```

# Certainty equivalent income

```{r}

set.seed(123)

# Parameters
W <- 1000          # initial wealth
premium <- 50      # insurance premium
risk_aversion <- 2 # CRRA coefficient

# Simulate yield shocks and indemnities
n <- 1000
yield_loss <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.2) * runif(n, 0, 300)  # 20% chance of loss
indemnity <- yield_loss                             # insurance pays loss

# Utility function (CRRA)
U <- function(x, rho) ifelse(rho == 1, log(x), (x^(1-rho))/(1-rho))

# Expected utility with insurance
EU_ins <- mean(U(W - premium + indemnity, risk_aversion))

# Certainty equivalent
CE <- (EU_ins * (1 - risk_aversion))^(1/(1 - risk_aversion))

cat("Certainty Equivalent with Insurance:", CE, "\n")

```

# Copula

The copula analysis answers the question

- Has the resilience of major cereals improved over time?

- What's the tail dependence of climatic variables, mean cereal yields, yield variance and crop yield dependence?

## Using ICRISAT District Data

```{r}
library(rio)

Kumar_Khanna2023=import("Kumar and Khanna 2023.dta")

library(janitor)

Kumar_Khanna2023=clean_names(Kumar_Khanna2023)
  
names(Kumar_Khanna2023)

Kumar_Khanna2023$maizeyieldkgperha=as.numeric(Kumar_Khanna2023$maizeyieldkgperha)

Kumar_Khanna2023$riceyieldkgperha[Kumar_Khanna2023$riceyieldkgperha> quantile(Kumar_Khanna2023$riceyieldkgperha, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)] <- NA

Kumar_Khanna2023$riceyieldkgperha[Kumar_Khanna2023$riceyieldkgperha< quantile(Kumar_Khanna2023$riceyieldkgperha, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)] <- NA

Kumar_Khanna2023$maizeyieldkgperha[Kumar_Khanna2023$maizeyieldkgperha> quantile(Kumar_Khanna2023$maizeyieldkgperha, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)] <- NA

Kumar_Khanna2023$maizeyieldkgperha[Kumar_Khanna2023$maizeyieldkgperha< quantile(Kumar_Khanna2023$maizeyieldkgperha, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)] <- NA

tail(sort(Kumar_Khanna2023$maizeyieldkgperha))

head(sort(Kumar_Khanna2023$maizeyieldkgperha))

Kumar_Khanna2023$maizeyieldtperha=Kumar_Khanna2023$maizeyieldkgperha/1000

Kumar_Khanna2023$riceyieldtperha=Kumar_Khanna2023$riceyieldkgperha/1000

Kumar_Khanna2023$wheatyieldtperha=Kumar_Khanna2023$wheatyieldkgperha/1000

Kumar_Khanna2023$time_trend=Kumar_Khanna2023$year-1966

Kumar_Khanna2023_sm=na.omit(Kumar_Khanna2023)
# Write formulae for parameters for the mean model, sigma model, and inefficiency model
# We use the original functional forms: identity for mean model, log sigma for sigma model and log ineff for the inefficiency

# Load packages
library("dplyr")
library("mgcv")
library("dsfa")
library("gamlss")
library("gamlss.add")
library("GJRM")

# Function for copula dependence parameter
delta_rw<-~~s(time_trend)
delta_rm<-~~time_trend
delta_wm<-~~time_trend

# Multi-output stochastic frontier with normal copula

# Output 1 frontier
mu_1_formula<-riceyieldtperha~s(time_trend)
sigma_v1_formula<-~s(time_trend)
sigma_u1_formula<-~s(time_trend)

# Output 2 frontier: wheat
mu_2_formula<-wheatyieldtperha~s(time_trend)
sigma_v2_formula<-~s(time_trend)
sigma_u2_formula<-~s(time_trend)

# Output 3 frontier: maize
mu_3_formula<-maizeyieldtperha~s(time_trend)
sigma_v3_formula<-~s(time_trend)
sigma_u3_formula<-~s(time_trend)

model_normal<-dsfa(formula=list(
  mu_1_formula,sigma_v1_formula,sigma_u1_formula, 
  mu_2_formula,sigma_v2_formula,sigma_u2_formula,
  delta_rw), data=Kumar_Khanna2023_sm,family=comper_mv(s=c(-1,-1), distr=c("normhnorm","normhnorm","normal")),
                   optimizer="efs",
                   control=list(trace=TRUE))

summary(model_normal)
plot(model_normal)
inefficiency<-efficiency(model_normal);
summary(inefficiency)


# Clayton
model_clayton <-dsfa(formula=list(mu_1_formula,sigma_v1_formula,sigma_u1_formula, mu_2_formula,sigma_v2_formula,sigma_u2_formula,delta_rw), data=Kumar_Khanna2023_sm,family=comper_mv(s=c(-1,-1), distr=c("normhnorm","normhnorm","clayton")),
                     optimizer="efs",
                     control=list(trace=TRUE))
summary(model_clayton)
plot(model_clayton)
inefficiency_clayton <-efficiency(model_clayton);
summary(inefficiency_clayton)


# Joe

 #                optimizer="efs",
```
